findings: `isTakeaway` false-positive on empty tableId — OrderTracking sets isTakeaway=true when tableId==='' which will flip the stepper to the takeaway track for any route that renders OrderTracking without a :tableId param. Drop the || tableId==='' guard and rely solely on order.isTakeaway from Firestore.

Double name entry on takeaway — CartDrawer initialises its own prenom state to '' and writes it to createOrder, ignoring the store's clientPrenom already set by TakeawayPage. Pre-fill the modal's prenom from useCartStore((s) => s.clientPrenom).

Phone validation not surfaced inline — the pattern attribute on TakeawayPage's phone input has no effect without a wrapping <form>; the only gate is CartDrawer's handlePlaceOrder. Add an onBlur regex check in TakeawayPage or disable the cart button while the phone is invalid.

Duplicate manifest definition — start_url and manifest fields are defined in both vite.config.ts (vite-plugin-pwa) and public/manifest.json (Firebase Hosting static). They are in sync now but will silently diverge on the next edit. Consolidate to a single source of truth.

Firestore index not yet deployed — the new (sessionId, createdAt) composite index in firestore.indexes.json must be deployed before the feature goes live (firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes); without it getOrdersBySessionId fails in production.

PICKUP caissier audio alert missing — CaissierDashboard's notification-sound logic filters only PENDING orders; PICKUP arrivals (customer walking in to collect) produce no audio alert. Include PICKUP in the alert filter if the sound is intended for that event.

PICKUP card message is hardcoded French — OrderTracking renders 'Votre commande est prête ! Venez la récupérer 🛍️' as a literal string with no i18n key; English-language clients see French text. Add order.countdown.pickup to both locale files.
